<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex87032023-03-0314-17-13" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed"> 
            <milestone unit="section" n="223.232.213.121.1 gzhan gyi 'dod pa rjes su brjod pa"/>
                    dang po ni tshogs pa'i spyi dang | dpe' <lb n="45a9"/> la yod pa'i khyad par rtags kyi mtshan gzhi' 'dod pa ni med mod kyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3834">kha cig</rs> la'i du ba lasogs pa rtsod gzhis khyad par du byas pa rtags kyi mtshan gzhir 'dod do ||<note type="editorial">This view in presented in Tshad ma rigs gter [CXRAK3IW] X 291,2, and attributed to "sTod lung rgya dmar ba la sogs pa dag" in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 223,17.</note></seg></TEI>
